adjudication.rationale: In the diff, many integrations switch token refresh calls to the new `refreshOAuthTokens(...)` helper so that when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED` and `CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT` are set, refresh happens via the parent app endpoint. However, `packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts` adds a direct `fetch("https://login.salesforce.com/services/oauth2/token", ...)` refresh flow and never uses `refreshOAuthTokens`. Therefore, in credential-sync deployments Salesforce will still refresh directly against Salesforce instead of delegating to the sync endpoint, contradicting the new behavior pattern introduced by this PR and potentially interfering with parent-managed tokens.
